prompts.title: Full-Stack Developer
prompts.description: Full-Stack Developer: plan, build, update, verify, review and release apps across stacks. Fill in the task and run Full-Stack Developer in one step.
prompts.content:
# Full-Stack Developer

Run /fs-developer and help me with the task below. Talk to me in plain words and ask only what you need from me.

* **Task:** `{{task}}`
* **Stage:** `{{stage}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`
* **Details:** `{{details}}`

If something you need is missing, ask for it in one short message, then continue.

Before you create, change, send, publish, or delete anything, show a short plan and wait for my yes. Read-only checks run without it.

task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Describe what you need in your own words.
task.context: What goes in, what should come out, and any rules it must follow.

stage.label: Stage
stage.context: Pick the step to run. Not sure: leave it on the first option and the entry skill decides. Skills: FS API Developer = /fs-developer:fs-api-developer; FS Architect = /fs-developer:fs-architect; FS DevOps Engineer = /fs-developer:fs-devops-engineer; FS Flutter Developer = /fs-developer:fs-flutter-developer; FS Maintainer = /fs-developer:fs-maintainer; FS Performance Engineer = /fs-developer:fs-performance-engineer; FS QA Engineer = /fs-developer:fs-qa-engineer; FS Release Manager = /fs-developer:fs-release-manager; FS Reviewer = /fs-developer:fs-reviewer; FS Security Engineer = /fs-developer:fs-security-engineer; FS UI Developer = /fs-developer:fs-ui-developer.
